cisco-psu-compatibility.purpose: C9200L-24P-4X supports PWR-C5-600WAC primary and secondary supplies; reference configuration populates both. PoE ports and Table 4: 30 W per downlink; 370 W available PoE with one PWR-C5-600WAC, 740 W with two. Delivered PoE budget is distinct from PSU output rating.

arista-psu-compatibility.purpose: Table 4 lists PWR-511-AC support for DCS-7050SX3-48C8; reference configuration populates both PSU positions.

core-psu-compatibility.purpose: Table 4 lists PWR-500AC support for DCS-7060CX-32S; reference configuration populates both PSU positions.

juniper-ex3300-port-modes.purpose: Pages 1-2 describe four shared 1G/10G uplink cages and the network-port option for the last two default Virtual Chassis ports; this catalog selects all four at 10G as standalone network ports.

juniper-ex3300-power.purpose: EX3300 has one internal fixed power supply. This installed configuration does not include the optional external redundant power system.

mx204-port-modes.purpose: Reviewed port-level configuration uses 100/100/100/0 Gbps plus eight 10G ports. Customer attachments configure 1G on the 10G cages; fourth 100G port remains disabled.

mx204-ac-power.purpose: Two installed AC PSU modules; 650 W PSU output rating is distinct from AC system input. Generator load allowance is explicitly authored.

juniper-inband-management.purpose: Dedicated management interface is not used as a data-plane transit path; this profile addresses lo0 inband and leaves fxp0 present, unaddressed and uncabled.

juniper-ex3300-poe.purpose: Tables 2, 3 and 7: Type 2 reserves 30 W at the PSE for up to 25.5 W at the PD; EX3300-24P has 24 PoE ports and a 405 W PoE budget. The 550 W supply rating is separate; no external redundant power system is installed.

reference-poe-v1.purpose: Authored reference operating and allocation policy: the portable AP envelope (wlan0/wlan1 radios; the default Cisco 9120 line declares its documented dual 5-GHz mode, the Aruba line a real 5 GHz + 2.4 GHz split); Type 2 PD maximum input 25500 mW and PSE reservation 30000 mW; one-supply-loss planning for every installed dual-supply access switch (Cisco C9200L, Juniper EX3400), none for the fixed-supply inherited EX3300; upstream AC planning allowance multiplier 1.25. These are design assumptions, not measured consumption, vendor efficiency or interoperability certification.

cisco-optics-host-json.purpose: Public TMG response for C9200L-24P-4X lists SFP-10G-LR: 10GBASE-LR, SFP+, duplex SMF LC/UPC, 10 km, minimum IOS XE 16.9.2. POST request parameters are preserved in poe-optics-bindings.json.

cisco-optics-host-notes.purpose: The exact C9200L-24P-4X/SFP-10G-LR lookup restricts support to fixed onboard uplinks; no module or fixed-copper substitution.

cisco-sfp-10g-power.purpose: Table 8: SFP-10G-LR maximum electrical power 1 W per module. Parsed primary page was readable; direct download returned 403.

juniper-ex3300-optics.purpose: Printed page 11 ordering table lists EX-SFP-10GE-LR for EX3300: 1310 nm, 10GBASE-LR, 10 km SMF. Catalog selects the four existing standalone 10G uplink cages. The same ordering table lists EX-SFP-10GE-SR: 850 nm, up to 300 m on MMF (fibre grade not stated).

juniper-mx204-optics-host.purpose: Exact MX204 HCT lists EX-SFP-10GE-LR on native SFP+ from Junos 17.4R1; SFP-1GE-LX on native SFP from 18.1R1; JNP-QSFP-100G-LR4 from 18.2R1. Selected port modes are separately bounded by mx204-port-modes; no QSA or breakout is modeled. The same HCT product page (re-fetched 2026-10-02) lists EX-SFP-10GE-SR natively on SFP+ and JNP-QSFP-100G-SR4 from 18.2R1.

juniper-ex-sfp-10ge-lr.purpose: Exact model HCT: duplex LC PC/UPC, 10 km selected SMF reach, maximum electrical module power 1000 mW. Original response bytes were hashed but not archived; the maximum field extraction is preserved separately.

juniper-sfp-1ge-lx.purpose: Exact model HCT: duplex LC PC/UPC, 10 km selected SMF reach, maximum electrical module power 1000 mW. Original response bytes were hashed but not archived; the maximum field extraction is preserved separately.

juniper-jnp-qsfp-100g-lr4.purpose: Exact model HCT: duplex LC PC/UPC, 10 km selected SMF reach, maximum electrical module power 3500 mW. Original response bytes were hashed but not archived; the maximum field extraction is preserved separately.

juniper-mx204-long-reach-optics-host.purpose: Exact MX204 HCT transceiver list includes SFP-1GE-LH (740-031849) from Junos OS 18.1R1 and QSFP-100G-ER4L (740-071175) from Junos OS 17.4R1, neither end-of-life. Installed only where an owned span outruns the 10 km LX/LR4 parts; no QSA or breakout is modeled.

juniper-sfp-1ge-lh.purpose: Exact model HCT: GE SFP LH, duplex LC PC/UPC, 70 km SMF distance, maximum power consumption 1 W. Vendor note: high Tx power, so appropriate optical attenuation is required on shorter links.

juniper-qsfp-100g-er4l.purpose: Exact model HCT: QSFP28 100G-ER4 Lite, duplex LC PC/UPC, 40 km distance; distance note: full 40 km requires host FEC, 30 km without FEC. Maximum power 5.0 W (0-70 C) and 5.5 W (0-75 C). The catalog selects the 30 km no-FEC reach and the 5.5 W maximum.

arista-transceiver-guide.purpose: Overview gives platform applicability unless restricted; actual cage form factor remains mandatory. Tables 6/10/14 distinguish SFP-10G-LR and QSFP-100G-LR4 from single-lambda LR; selected LR/LR4 are duplex SMF, 10 km. LR4/AOC minimum EOS 4.15.2 also requires the chassis minimum release. Tables 10/12 (SFP-10G-SR: duplex LC MMF, OM3 300 m / OM4 400 m) and Tables 6/14.0 (QSFP-100G-SR4: MPO-12 MMF, OM3 70 m / OM4 100 m); neither row restricts platforms, so the overview's all-platform rule applies.

arista-transceiver-datasheet.purpose: Physical specifications and exact AOC-Q-Q-100G-3M ordering entry (printed page 22): one 3 m preterminated optical assembly with QSFP28 ends. No explicit SFP-10G-LR electrical maximum was established by this review. Printed page 6 'Power Requirements (Maximum)' gives 1 W for SFP/SFP+ optics (SFP-10G-SR).

arista-7050-optics-host-indexed.purpose: Parsed primary HCL explicitly lists SFP-10G-LR, QSFP-100G-LR4 and AOC-Q-Q-100G-3M against 7050SX3-48C8/48C8C. The HCL is DMF-scoped: its FEC defaults do not establish EOS defaults. Raw HTTP returned challenge HTML, not the HCL, so no original HCL hash is asserted.

arista-100g-qa.purpose: Printed page 5 maximum-power table gives QSFP-100G-LR4 4.5 W and AOC 3.5 W. AOC end-versus-assembly scope is not explicit: reserving 3.5 W at each captive end (7 W total) is an authored conservative interpretation. The same table gives QSFP-100G-SR4 3.5 W; page 7 lists its MPO connector.

fortinet-100f-optics-host-indexed.purpose: Indexed printed page 8 ordering table for FG-100F/101F includes FN-TRAN-SFP+LR. Direct Japanese/English PDFs returned 404; original revision/hash and software minimum remain unknown. This supports the exact family accessory choice, not arbitrary FortiOS or multivendor certification.

fortinet-transceivers.purpose: Printed page 5 FN-TRAN-SFP+LR: SFP+, 10GBASE-LR, 1310 nm duplex LC SMF, 10 km; published power dissipation 850 mW is not explicitly a maximum. The 1000 mW reservation is authored. Generic optic data alone does not establish host compatibility.

reference-optics-v1.purpose: Authored policy: 3–100 m complete known local SMF paths; no carrier-span or optical-loss claim. Server eth1/eth2 use a generic third-party SFP-10G-LR, duplex LC SMF, 10 km nominal reach and an authored 2000 mW envelope. Arista 10G uses a 2000 mW planning reserve, Fortinet rounds published 850 mW to 1000 mW, and each AOC captive end reserves 3500 mW. Add ceil(sum installed module/end mW per host × 1.25 / 1000) once alongside unchanged chassis and PoE allowances. The multiplier is an authored margin, not measured efficiency. In-room jumpers between two cages that both carry a reviewed short-reach part run on OM4 multimode with SR/SR4 optics; a generic third-party SFP-10G-SR (duplex LC, 400 m on OM4, authored 1000 mW envelope) serves server eth1/eth2. Long-reach single-mode stays for building backbones, carrier handoffs and owned spans, and for any cage (the FortiGate 100F) without a reviewed multimode part.

juniper-ex3400-ports.purpose: EX3400-24P front panel: 24 Gigabit Ethernet RJ-45 ports labeled 0-23 as PIC 0 and four SFP/SFP+ uplink cages as PIC 2; two rear QSFP+ ports are configured as Virtual Chassis ports by default; RJ-45 console on the rear panel and Mini-USB Type-B console on the front panel. This catalog selects the four shared uplink cages at 10G as xe-0/2/0 through xe-0/2/3 and models the two default VCPs as stacking ports.

juniper-ex3400-power-poe.purpose: Table 1: EX3400-24P has 24 PoE-enabled ports; maximum system power available for PoE is 370 W with one 600 W power supply installed and 720 W with two. The maximum power available on a PoE+ port is 30 W. Table 2: JPSU-600-AC-AFO is the 600 W AC supply, minimum one and maximum two per chassis, installed in slots PSU 0 and PSU 1; the AC cord coupler is IEC 60320 type C13, which mates a C14 chassis inlet. Delivered PoE budget is distinct from PSU output rating.

juniper-ex3400-optics.purpose: EX3400 Hardware Compatibility Tool transceiver list includes EX-SFP-10GE-LR (Juniper part 740-021309) from Junos OS 15.1X53-D50. Catalog installs it only in the four selected 10G uplink cages. The same list includes EX-SFP-10GE-SR.

qfx5120-port-modes.purpose: QFX5120-48Y front panel has 48 SFP28 ports and 8 QSFP28 ports. The SFP28 ports are grouped in quads and are configured to operate at 10-Gbps speed by default; this catalog keeps that default and records it as an explicit interface speed. Junos surfaces a 10G port with the xe- prefix; the pinned device-type library names all 48 cages et-0/0/0 through et-0/0/47 and this catalog keeps the pinned names. The rear panel has two RJ-45 management ports labeled C0 and C1 and one RJ-45 console port labeled CON.

qfx5120-management-names.purpose: The management ports em0 (labeled C0) and em1 (labeled C1) are on the rear panel of the QFX5120-48Y. This catalog models only em0; the pinned device-type library instead declares a single fxp0, which is not the documented name for this platform. The unused second management port is not modeled.

qfx5120-ac-power.purpose: QFX5120-48Y supports two 650 W AC power supplies, model JPSU-650W-AC-AO (airflow out) or JPSU-650W-AC-AI, installed in slots labeled 0 and 1; the AC cord coupler is IEC 60320 type C13, which mates a C14 chassis inlet. The AFO2 SKU ships two AC supplies with front-to-back airflow. PSU output rating is distinct from the authored chassis allowance.

qfx5120-optics-host.purpose: Exact QFX5120-48Y HCT transceiver list includes EX-SFP-10GE-LR (740-021309), JNP-QSFP-100G-LR4 (740-061409) and JNP-100G-AOC-3M (740-065631), each from Junos OS 18.3R1 and none end-of-life. No breakout or channelized mode is modeled. The same list includes EX-SFP-10GE-SR and JNP-QSFP-100G-SR4, from 18.3R1 and not end-of-life.

juniper-jnp-100g-aoc-3m.purpose: QSFP28 100G active optical cable, 3 m, maximum power consumption 3.5 W. The published figure does not distinguish whole assembly from individual captive end; reserving 3500 mW at each end is an authored conservative interpretation, matching the existing Arista AOC policy.

server-psu.purpose: Supermicro's SYS-1029U-E1CRTP2 page lists two PWS-751P-1R 1U 750W redundant Platinum supplies, two onboard 10G SFP+ and two 1GbE ports (Intel X710-AM2 / i350-AM2) and one dedicated IPMI LAN port. The pinned device-type library has no PWS-751P-1R module type, so the module model comes from this page; the inlet type is the C14 the library's other 1U Supermicro PWS modules declare. No original-page hash is asserted.

ap-cisco-datasheet.purpose: Catalyst 9120AX data sheet: Flexible Radio Assignment and a documented dual 5-GHz mode in which both radios operate on 5 GHz; one 100/1000/2500 Multigigabit RJ-45 uplink; 802.3at PoE+ with 25.5 W maximum consumption on PoE+. The -B (FCC) and -E (ETSI) part numbers differ by regulatory domain only.

generic-design-v1.purpose: Generic, unbranded equipment authored for this project: wired endpoints, ATMs, the liquid-cooled laboratory pair and third-party optics. Dimensions, ports and supplies are explicit design assumptions, not a vendor product.

srlinux-container.purpose: ghcr.io/nokia/srlinux:26.7.2 (sha256:0096fe3ebcafabb7253492e2060425fe027a168e0e066766d1e85efbb0b48be8, arm64) under containerlab 0.79.0 reports chassis type 7220 IXR-D2L, serial 'Sim Serial No.' and, through the orb-agent 2.15.0 nokia_srl driver, platform 'NOKIA_SRL v26.7.2' (lab/discovery/README.md). The catalog keeps those strings verbatim so real discovery of the lab matches its records; the devicetype-library model string '7220 IXR-D2L 25/100GE' is the labelled deviation. The container emulates no power supply, fan or optic.

juniper-ex-sfp-10ge-sr.purpose: Exact model HCT (740-021308): 10GBASE-SR, MMF, duplex LC PC/UPC, OM3 300 m / OM4 400 m, maximum power consumption 1 W. Platforms: MX204 17.4R1 (native SFP+), QFX5120-48Y 18.3R1, EX3400 15.1X53-D50. EX3300 support rests on its own datasheet (juniper-ex3300-optics). Response bytes hashed, not archived.

juniper-jnp-qsfp-100g-sr4.purpose: Exact model HCT (740-061405): IEEE 802.3bm 100GBASE-SR4, MMF, MPO-12 PC/UPC, OM3 70 m / OM4 100 m, maximum power consumption 3.5 W. Platforms: MX204 18.2R1, QFX5120-48Y 18.3R1. No breakout is modeled.

cisco-optics-host-notes-sr.purpose: TMG notes for C9200L-24P-4X / SFP-10G-SR (POST networkModelId 1767, softwareReleaseId 1522, transceiverModelId 73): fixed onboard uplinks only; OM3 300 m, OM4/OM5 400 m. The archived C9200L search response (cisco-optics-host-json) lists the SFP-10G-SR row: 10GBASE-SR, duplex MMF LC/UPC, IOS XE 16.9.2.

access.description: Verified chassis/interface inventory with an explicit two-PWR-C5-600WAC installed PSU configuration. Power ports are materialized from module templates, not fixed chassis ports.

access-juniper.description: Verified EX3400-24P chassis and interface inventory with two installed JPSU-600-AC-AFO supplies. Power ports are materialized from the supply module template, not fixed chassis ports. The four shared 1G/10G uplink cages are selected at 10G; the two rear QSFP+ ports are the platform's default Virtual Chassis ports and are modeled as stacking ports. Airflow variants, the optional 150 W and 920 W supplies, DC power and Virtual Chassis membership beyond two are not modeled.

inherited-access.description: Verified EX3300-24P inventory with one fixed internal AC supply. All four shared-mode uplink cages are explicitly configured as 10G network ports, including ports 2 and 3 normally assigned to Virtual Chassis. Alternative ge-0/1/* personalities are omitted to avoid duplicating physical ports. Inherited describes fictional procurement provenance, not vendor lifecycle status; no external redundant power system is modeled.

leaf.description: Verified chassis/interface inventory with two PWR-511-AC-RED supplies in positions 0 and 1. Power ports materialize the upstream {module} template; the same model may serve leaf or spine roles.

leaf-juniper.description: Verified QFX5120-48Y-AFO2 chassis and interface inventory with two installed JPSU-650W-AC-AO supplies, the same 650 W AC module the MX204 uses. Power ports materialize the upstream {module} template. The 48 SFP28 cages keep the platform's default 10-Gbps port mode, recorded as an explicit interface speed; Junos would surface a 10G port as xe-, while this catalog keeps the pinned device-type library's et-0/0/N names. Only management port C0 (em0) is modeled; C1 and channelized breakout modes are not.

core.description: Verified chassis/interface inventory with two PWR-500AC-F supplies in positions 0 and 1. Power ports materialize the upstream {module} template. 32 native 100G ports; breakout modes are not modeled.

edge.description: Verified source inventory. Shared-media port17-port20 use the source optical personality; no additional copper interfaces are invented for the same ports.

server.description: Verified SYS-1029U-E1CRTP2 chassis and interface inventory: dedicated BMC, onboard eth1/eth2 10G SFP+ data ports and eth3/eth4 1GbE, DE-9 serial. Two installed PWS-751P-1R supplies in bays PSU1/PSU2 materialize the C14 inlets. PCI-E and drive bays are not modeled.

patch-panel.model: Cat 6 Punchdown Patch Panel, 24 Ports, 1 RU, Black
patch-panel.description: Verified Panduit DP24688TGY: 24 front 8P8C jacks mapped one-to-one to 110 punchdown rear terminations; passive.

pdu.description: Verified APC AP9572 Basic Rack PDU: Zero U, 16A 208/230V, one C20 inlet and fifteen C13 outlets; no network management.

pdu-120.description: Verified APC AP9563 Basic Rack PDU: 1U, 20A 120V, one NEMA 5-20P inlet and ten NEMA 5-20R outlets; no network management.

endpoint.description: Generic non-rack-mounted endpoint: one 1G Ethernet interface, one C14 AC inlet. Authored example appliance, not a vendor product.

atm.description: Generic non-rack-mounted ATM: one 1G Ethernet interface, one C14 AC inlet. Authored example appliance, not a vendor product.

ap.description: Cisco Catalyst 9120AXI-B: one 2.5GBASE-T Type 2 powered uplink and two 802.11ax radios run in the documented dual 5-GHz mode. Pinned source is the -E (ETSI) part; US estates install the -B (FCC) variant, which differs by regulatory domain only. Interface names follow the portable endpoint convention (eth0, wlan0, wlan1); the vendor names are GigabitEthernet0, Dot11Radio0/1. The console and USB ports are not modeled.

ap-aruba.description: Verified Aruba AP-505 inventory: one 1000BASE-T Type 2 powered port and two 802.11ax radios, one 5 GHz and one 2.4 GHz. Interface names follow this generator's portable endpoint convention (eth0, wlan0, wlan1); the vendor labels the wired port E0 and identifies radios by band, and no vendor interface-naming claim is made. The Type 2 envelope below is the IEEE class-4 PD maximum and PSE reservation, not a measured or vendor consumption figure for this model. The optional 12 Vdc input, the USB port, the serial console and the Bluetooth/Zigbee radio are not modeled.

wall-outlet.description: Verified generic one-position 8P8C wall box: rear horizontal termination and front endpoint patch connection.

console-server.description: Verified Opengear CM8116: 16 RJ45 serial ports, dual built-in C14 supplies, NET1/NET2 management Ethernet. NET1 is the cabled management port; NET2 stays spare.

liquid-chassis.description: Generic 2U one-blade enclosure: internal power and coolant distribution, independent management controller; 400W planning allowance includes the child blade.

liquid-blade.description: Generic child blade powered through its enclosure. Dedicated management, coolant intake and one diagnostic device context; no physical production application links are claimed.

provider-edge.description: Pinned MX204 chassis and interface inventory; two explicitly installed JPSU-650W-AC-AO modules. Generator selects three 100G ports plus eight 10G ports, disables the fourth 100G port, and uses lo0 for inband management. Fan population and certified transceiver choices are not modeled.

console-server-48.description: Verified Opengear CM8148: 48 RJ45 serial ports, dual built-in C14 supplies, NET1/NET2 management Ethernet. NET1 is the cabled management port; NET2 stays spare.

lab-router.description: Software emulation only: a Nokia SR Linux container standing in for a 7220 IXR-D2L in the provider's network lab (discovery_lab recipe key). Front panel follows the pinned devicetype-library file (48 SFP28, 8 QSFP28, 2 SFP+, mgmt0); model, serial and platform strings are what the container itself reports. No PSU, fan, optic or power draw is modeled.

fortinet-10g-lr.power_basis: authored round-up from published 850mW dissipation; worst-case maximum not established

juniper-1g-lh.installation_note: in-line attenuator fitted per the vendor's short-link note
